name: AIA Research · contextual AI assistance
data: Fictional prototype data only. No client data, no live calls.

shell: Research rail (7 stages; vertical >=1280px unless the panel is open below 1600px)
workspace: Stage heading row: eyebrow, h1#stage-title, lead | AI context card
Active stage editor (baseline component, kept mounted after first visit)
results: 1 Zjištění: finding | client knowledge + Deep Research context
2 Důkazy: aggregation tables; Sociomap | read-only legend & method aside
4 Další krok: researcher review note, internal exports

tokens.source: apps/web/src/app/tokens.css + tokens-theme.css (light & dark), copied verbatim into the helmet

critique_design.label: AI zkontroluje návrh
critique_design.start: one click from card or panel; no question
critique_design.result: advice (Odpověď AI · Zavřít); the design is not changed

design_copilot.label: Zeptat se na návrh
design_copilot.start: opens panel with question field; sends only on explicit submit

answer_memory.label: Zeptat se na klientské znalosti
answer_memory.start: opens panel with question field; sends only on explicit submit
doesNotSee: result or sociomap values unless the user types them into the question

analyze_brief.label: Vytvořit návrh s AI
analyze_brief.note: Existing baseline action; its job state uses the same panel. Proposal applies only after review in stage 2.

cardRules.scope: always visible on card and in panel ('Co AI uvidí')

actions.concurrency: One AI job per study. While a job is active every AI start control is disabled with 'Jiný AI krok ještě běží.'
actions.beforeSend: Pending edits are saved and a new design revision is created (submitDesign).
actions.cost: Spustí AI úlohu na pozadí · platí se z rozpočtu studie; reservation shown while running, actual cost after completion.

states.saving: Ukládám rozpracované změny a vytvářím revizi návrhu.
states.running: AI zpracovává návrh · real elapsed time · no percentage or ETA · cancel armed after 3 s
states.waiting: WAITING_PROVIDER / ai_runtime_unavailable: job is stored, nothing sent; only an explicit 'Pokračovat v úloze' resumes the same job id
states.failed: HTTP 504 while polling: status unknown, job may still run; only 'Obnovit stav' (refresh, no resubmit)
states.refused: Runtime switch off: nothing sent, nothing billed; dismiss only
states.cancelConfirm: Opravdu chcete tento běh zrušit? Rozpracovaný krok se bezpečně ukončí.
states.cancelled: AI krok byl zrušen. Zadání zůstává uložené.
states.done: Answer opens in panel and is added to 'Uložené návrhy AI'; reopening a saved answer never calls the model
states.readOnly: Viewer: no AI start controls; saved answers readable; review note disabled
states.export: Immediate 'Žádost přijata…' → completion message with file name; no fake progress

persistence.stageEditors: mounted on first visit and kept mounted (hidden) so in-editor drafts survive navigation

preserved: intervals and support on every number
Deep Research kept separate from run data

accessibility.focus: Global :focus-visible 2px --signal outline; stage change focuses h1#stage-title; panel open focuses heading or question; completion focuses the answer
accessibility.escape: Escape closes the panel and returns focus to the invoking control (fallback: card primary)
accessibility.dialog: <1024px panel is role=dialog aria-modal with backdrop and Tab trap
accessibility.sidePanel: >=1024px panel is role=complementary, nonmodal; workspace and maps remain interactive
accessibility.live: Job phase and save/export status use role=status / aria-live=polite
accessibility.reducedMotion: No animations; prefers-reduced-motion disables transitions and smooth scrolling
accessibility.contrast: Ink on wash/raised surfaces; no alpha-muted text on accents

responsive.1440: Sidebar 240 + rail 224 (horizontal while panel open) + main + 380 side panel
responsive.768: No sidebar; horizontal rail; card wraps under heading; panel as right-anchored dialog min(440px, 100vw)
responsive.390: 16px padding; card full width; panel full-screen dialog; findings and map aside stack

timing.localFeedback: < 400 ms (navigation, panel open, prefill, saved-answer reopen)
timing.serverModelWork: shown as pending with real elapsed time until the job reports a terminal state

methodologyNote: Next round (Settings → Metodika): the latest methodology supports multiple editable modules. The version editor must not be limited to the object map.
